sources.snippet: Overview parakeet-tdt-.6b-v3-coreml is a 600-million-parameter multilingual automatic speech recognition model converted to Apple's Core ML format, maintained by FluidInference. This model implements the FastConformer Token Duration Transducer (TDT) architecture and supports 25 European languages with optimized inference on Apple Silicon.
